portals.observation: The official government Q&A identifies Qinhuangdao’s municipal real-estate registration center and directs residents to the municipal bureau registration portal for service guides. Its online information search accepts a certificate number, property-unit number, or address and returns property facts/restriction status; owner queries require identity verification. No search, certificate scan, address, or unit number was supplied. No geometry-only route was verified.
